Class StaffCredentialsRepository

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.iam.staff.StaffCredentialsRepository
@Repository public class StaffCredentialsRepository extends Object
Repository for staff sign-in credentials: looking a staff member up by email and recording the outcome of each sign-in attempt.
